name: saas_intelligence
instructions: Extract product pricing, API support, SDKs, and value proposition from the supplied source spans.

pricing_type.description: How the product is priced, stated explicitly in the source; unknown when pricing is not mentioned.

has_api.description: True only when the source documents a public API with cited evidence.

supported_sdks.description: SDKs or client libraries named verbatim in the source, never inferred.

core_value_prop.description: The product's core value proposition in one sentence supported only by the cited quotes.
